summary: Guide operators through Docker group activation after host preparation
details: Host checks distinguish an account already registered in the Docker group from a terminal still using its old groups. They explain how to reconnect with the same account or use newgrp docker, recheck access and resume setup or doctor/up without reinstalling software or repeating node configuration.

The host helper returns status 20 when session refresh is the only observed blocker, including after installation when elevated Docker access works but operator access does not. prepare-host pauses without offering another package installation; simultaneous failed checks remain failures and must also be resolved.

Node commands report DOCKER_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED as an action-required message instead of a raw subprocess exception. Other host helper failures retain their detailed check output and receive a concise HOST_PREREQUISITES_FAILED summary. Commands remain unsuccessful until their checks pass; no existing shell permissions or node services are changed automatically.
